description: Mary's Room stage 4.5 (seed 3): the COLOUR PROPERTY of a perceived PersistentSurface (surface_persistence), by the vision_lighting T3/L1 von Kries arithmetic. Per surface matched at epoch e: c_ch = Round(mean member L/M/S caught_quanta, 0) -- LINEAR catches (photon_transduce: adaptation enters only the activation; cone dark current 0), on a declared integer quanta lattice (|eps|<=1/2). FrameStats anchor a_ch = MaxOver(matched surfaces, c_ch) (T3's anchor, constant-free). First sight mints ONE ColourProperty{p=c, pa=a, minted_epoch} via has_colour_property (descriptor p/pa). RUNG 1 (L1 bound): later, HOLDS iff per channel |c*pa - p*a| <= 1/2(c+pa+p+a) (+1/4 per bracket with a zero lattice value). DERIVATION: in-class (diagonal) change gives c*pa* = p*a* exactly (round is monotone so the anchor is the same material); with all four observed values rounded, D = c pa - p a = [c e_pa + pa e_c - e_c e_pa] - [p e_a + a e_p - e_p e_a]; each bracket is bilinear on [-1/2,1/2]^2 so its range is [-(x+y)/2 - 1/4, (x+y)/2 - 1/4] for x,y >= 1/2 and the -1/4 corner terms cancel in the difference: |D| <= (c+pa+p+a)/2; a zero lattice value widens its bracket by 1/4. Every term is a half-step rounding times its own cross-multiplier (L1 PREREG 2.1/2.2); nothing tuned. It bounds rounding only, NOT the model error of this eye's non-diagonal sensors, so refusals under illuminant A are the reported result. Verdict on PropertyCheck{epoch, sid, status holds|refused, resid_*, bound_*, resid_max, margin}; the property is never changed. RUNG 2 (flag pooled; L3b leave-one-out with surfaces as locales): gain g_ch = c/p; G^(-K) = Chebyshev centre of the other checks' gains (same frame, same reference epoch), tolerance = their own spread MaxOver|g_j - G|; pooled_status holds_pooled|refused_pooled (empty pool / zero p refuse). Flags ColourPropertyParams{enabled, pooled}, OFF by default (sec 9). See tools/build_colour_property_seed.py. v1.1.0 (description only; rules unchanged): SATURATION DOES NOT AFFECT THE PROPERTY PATH. caught_quanta is linear in the photons (cognitive_tasks.rs photon_transduce: caught = dark + sum count*exp(-z^2/2)); only the activation caught/(caught + half_saturation + adaptation) saturates, and this seed reads catches only (pre-saturation). Measured at 1e5 td (cone activations 0.91-0.998 at first sight): per-cell catches equal the packet-linear oracle, properties equal the lattice of the linear catches, E->E checks hold with residual 0 (rung 1) and holds_pooled (rung 2), while SurfaceLooks compress (tests/test_stage4_fixes_migrated.py). So no refusal of saturated cells is needed or built for properties; saturation is a property of looks.

rules.name: cp_catch
rules.comment: Per segment S applied by persistence at the ready epoch (so S -segment_of-> P exists): the surface's mean LINEAR cone catch per channel over its member cells, put on the integer quanta lattice: c_ch = Round(Sum(member caught_quanta)/n, 0). Gated on every member's L/M/S receptor carrying this epoch.

rules.name: cp_frame
rules.comment: ONE FrameStats per epoch, once every applied boundary segment of the ready epoch has its surface's catch: the anchor a_ch = MaxOver(surfaces matched this epoch, c_ch) -- T3's li_frame_stats anchor, constant-free (the brightest surface per channel acts as the scene white). No frame for an epoch with no surface (ganzfeld).

rules.name: cp_frame_retire
rules.comment: Keep old FrameStats as history (has_frame) but drop the live current_frame edge once a newer frame exists.

rules.name: cp_mint
rules.comment: The FIRST epoch a PersistentSurface is seen it gets ONE ColourProperty: p_ch = its lattice catch, pa_ch = that frame's anchor (descriptor = anchor-relative reflectance p/pa), via P -has_colour_property-> CP. A PropertyCheck{status 'minted', resid 0} records the epoch. Never re-minted.

rules.name: cp_check
rules.comment: RUNG 1 (L1 bound). At a later matched epoch the property HOLDS iff for every channel |c*pa - p*a| <= 1/2(c+pa+p+a) (+1/4 per cross-term with a zero lattice value) -- the rounding envelope derived in the seed description; no tuned constant. Verdict written on a PropertyCheck (refusal is a positive datum, l1_refuse). The property is NOT changed. Also writes the anchor-free gain g_ch = c/p for rung 2 (g_ok = 0 if some p_ch is 0: gain unidentifiable).

rules.name: cp_pool
rules.comment: RUNG 2 (pooled flag): L3b l3b_pool_loo with surfaces as locales. Once every surface of the frame is checked, K's leave-one-out pool (same frame, same reference epoch, not K) gives G^(-K) = the Chebyshev centre of the pool's gains (Argmin_i MaxOver_j L-inf |g_i - g_j|). Fires once per check.

rules.name: cp_pool_none
rules.comment: RUNG 2 refusal by construction: an empty leave-one-out pool, or an unidentifiable own gain, can never acquire an estimate (L3b: an absence must not read as a value) -> refused_pooled with its reason.

rules.name: cp_corroborate
rules.comment: RUNG 2 verdict: holds_pooled iff |g_K,ch - G_ch| <= spread_ch on every channel, spread_ch = MaxOver(pool, |g_j,ch - G_ch|) -- the pool's own non-diagonality, data-derived, not tuned. Writes dev_* and spread_* so the verdict is a measurement.
